case.pattern_description: 4 online purchases were made on this card inside 25.2 minutes, each amount parked just beneath the $200 authorisation ceiling (mean headroom 0.04%), totalling $799.70. The shape defeats per-transaction review because every individual leg looks ordinary; only the burst as a whole is anomalous. It was found by scanning the card's recent online activity for clusters concentrated immediately below round authorisation thresholds, and matches five confirmed-fraud closed cases (CC-3748, CC-3841, CC-3907, CC-4086, CC-4124) that the bank's own analysts could not fit to a documented typology.
